We can ask them step-by-step using single-select or multi-select etc. Let's start asking for departure location via single-select? But we don't have predefined cities; better use free input? There's no tool for free-text entry. So perhaps just ask question directly. We'll prompt them manually. Then proceed accordingly.

2. Arrival city/airport?
